main_text.l: tus Sanctus movens volūtatem cogitatione mā- dati divini ad timorem Dei & veram castitatem. ver.9. An peccarem in Deum? In aliis voluntas foris abhorrens à manifesta turpitudine: Sed intus immunditiem retinens, flammis ardens, nec Deum timens,
iii. à causa finali: Iosephus abstinet ne offendat Deum; alii gloriolam continentiæ captant.
Amplificentur hæ duæ causæ ex Thesi, de dis- crimine virtutum in sanctis & in non renatis.
iiii. Ab adiunctis. Iosephi castitatem comitantur præclaræ aliæ virtutes.
i. Pietas, obtemperans Deo: v.9. Quarefacerem malum?
2. Fides rectè agnoscens Deum, & voluntatem eius:&c.
3. Fidelitas in herum: non abutitur sua potestate, nec vult herum fallere cum possit. ver.8.
4. Gratitudo agnoscens & profitens beneficia accepta: nec voles[?] reddere malum pro bono.
5. Constantia servans σωφροσύνην[?] rectè faciendi, etsi sæpius tentetur illecebris lascivæ mulieris. ver.10.
6. Fortitudo anteferens virtutem & bonam conscientiam certo periculo.
Obiectio. Videtur à Deo deseri abiectus in carcerem.
Resp. 1. Ex dicto: virtutis comes invidia: Item: Careat successibus opto / Quisquis ab eventu facta notanda putat.
2. In carcere Deus adest carceri, cumque tandem evehit.

page.notes: The Greek word after "servans" is read as σωφροσύνην with doubt; the letters are not clear on the scan. The word "voles" after "nec" is doubtful. "Ab adiunctis" is printed with little space and is read as two words. The mark before "Amplificentur" and the mark over "Resp." are printer's ornaments and are not transcribed.
